sources.scope: AR only; 100 country-tagged surnames, snapshot of Wikipedia published surname tables (July 2023)
sources.use: Preserved ranked family-name spellings and Latin diacritics; entries selected before secondary source
sources.license_note: Repository describes dataset as CC0; upstream table provenance requires independent review

sources.scope: AR only; directory-derived surname-labelled entries, locatefamily.com snapshot (July 2019)
sources.use: Additional source-observed entries; numeric percentages deliberately discarded; require occurrence in at least one other batch-D country and exclude known first names, entity labels and invalid entries
sources.limitations: Noisy non-official directory extraction and ASCII-only spellings; where this source lacks diacritics they have not been conjecturally restored. Individual surname identity/licensing audit remains necessary before release

sources.scope: AR — surnames of Argentina residents from December 2021 RENAPER records; unique national surname set derived from province tallies, minimum >10 bearers per province
sources.method: Only attested single surname tokens selected. Pinned processed source is lowercased; normalized display capitalization; no conjectural accent restoration and no counts imported.
sources.license_note: RENAPER public dataset CC BY 4.0; processed mirror reproducibility and reuse terms require review
